intro: We do not publish flat prices for HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical or construction work, because an honest number depends on the equipment, the access, the building and what is actually wrong with it. What we will do is give you a free written quote after a real diagnosis, explain the reasoning behind any repair-versus-replace recommendation, and tell you plainly if your existing equipment still has life in it. Our position on cost has not changed in 24 years: the cheapest visit and the cheapest outcome are rarely the same thing, and we would rather show you the arithmetic than win the job on a number that does not hold up.
notes: Free estimates for residential and commercial work across Miami-Dade, Broward and Monroe Counties. Call (305) 885-4422 to schedule.
